name: Draft Picker
summary: Stop the round and ask a question: one of N cards, in screen space, with real text and a click target.
description: Between rounds a roguelite asks you to choose, and the answer has to be readable or it is not a question, it is a guess. Each card carries a title, what it does, its group and a footer -- which is where a stacking game says how many you already hold, without which a third damage mod looks exactly like a first. Selectable by number key or by clicking, so it works on a pad and a phone. Was world-space sprites labelled with colour and pips until the UI globals arrived; that was a workaround for having neither a viewport nor a font, and it did not outlive the problem.
nextSteps: Put DraftBoard.js on an empty manager actor and tag it Draft -- it builds its own elements at start.
setHeading and setHint, then open(3), then setCard(slot, title, body, group, colour) for each.
Use setFooter to say how many the player already holds; a stacking game is illegible without it.
Poll getPicked() until it is not -1, and give the player a timeout so a run cannot stall on the board.
